author: projectsagana
text:
Here's a chart of USDJPY

I've been trying to figure out what are the "A Trade" set ups for me. This particular "A Trade" set up I've been studying has appeared on this h4 time frame. It's a bullish reversal trade set up. Price must be in down trend prior to this set up. Then price bases in a range for a moment, then rises for a leg up when supply and demand hit an imbalance state of price action. The leg up then makes a higher high breaking the down trend line. So a rally-base-rally demand zone have formed. I set up a long limit order on that demand zone with a stop loss just below it and an automatic 2:1 target. I just wait for the price to arrive to the zone and fill my order and let the market do its thing.

So that's what I saw on the Japanese Yen against the US Dollar over and over again on the 4h time frame.
